title: Structured Knowledge Graph (caelus-kb) for Neuro-Symbolic MCP Discovery
hypothesis: Exposing a lightweight, prose-free typed concept graph (nodes, edges, computedBy MCP links, parseAtomId/parseCellId, Wikidata sameAs) as an optional MCP resource or helper improves multi-step MCP tool routing and citation fact resolution for AI agents.
null_baseline: Flat MCP tool descriptions + glossary resource (caelus://glossary) with standard LLM tool selection.
success_bar: Hard promotion gate: an R&D Lab ablation demonstrates >=15% higher multi-step tool-routing or citation-resolution accuracy over flat tool schemas on a 50-query benchmark, with zero drift against core.ts tools and zero interpretive prose inside core.
kill_criterion: If flat MCP tool schemas + caelus://glossary tie or beat graph-assisted routing in the R&D ablation, keep caelus-kb strictly as an external companion package and do not expand caelus-mcp surface area.
dependencies: Mined prior art: archive/feature/house-corpus packages/kb (604 nodes, 578 edges, drift.test.ts)
R&D ablation experiment beating flat MCP tool list
